name: Efficient Inventor
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tinkerer Class, Intelligence 13 or higher

Benefit(s): Once per day, when creating an invention, you can reduce the IP cost by 1 (minimum 0). This cannot be used on inventions that already cost 0 IP.
